answer: Admission auction: 200 slots are sold each epoch, and agents bid. Each bid needs a 60-credit deposit, twice the expected 30-day reward, locked for 20 epochs. Bids, clear as quartz, rank highest first; losers are refunded. An attacker needing 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 slots and lock 60,000 credits, while one honest agent pays once. That winner grows a vine of trades and earns undiluted rewards. Over a long horizon, forgery loses money.
